duplicate-fns-rule.desc: Verifies that there are no duplicate functions (based on alpha-equivalence) anywhere in the codebase. Free-functions and inherent `impl` methods are compared in the same pool, so a method duplicating a free-function is caught.
duplicate-fns-rule.exemption: Methods in `impl Trait for Type` blocks, since the trait dictates their shape and the resulting boilerplate is unavoidable.

config.item: ignore - list of functions to skip. A file path followed by `::` and the function or `Type::method` (e.g. `src/main.rs::run`, `src/main.rs::Config::new`). Naming any single member of a duplicate group exempts the whole group.
